extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. Use speechManager.speakNumber() for reading numbers aloud. The game must teach: (1) Calendar — a calendar shows days, weeks, and months. 1 week = 7 days (Monday through Sunday). 1 year = 12 months (January through December). Months have 30 or 31 days (February has 28 or 29). Use a calendar to find: what day is the 15th? How many Sundays in this month? What date is next Monday? (2) Reading time (am/pm and 12hr/24hr) — AM = before noon (midnight to noon), PM = after noon (noon to midnight). 12-hour clock: uses AM and PM (e.g. 3:00 PM). 24-hour clock: no AM/PM, hours go from 00 to 23 (e.g. 15:00 = 3:00 PM). (3) Converting 12hr to 24hr — for AM times: same hour, just add 0 in front if needed (8:00 AM = 08:00, 12:00 AM = 00:00). For PM times: add 12 to the hour (1:00 PM = 13:00, 3:00 PM = 15:00, 6:00 PM = 18:00, 12:00 PM = 12:00). To convert 24hr back to 12hr: if hour > 12, subtract 12 and add PM (15:00 = 3:00 PM, 18:00 = 6:00 PM). If hour < 12, keep and add AM (08:00 = 8:00 AM). (4) Days to hours and hours to minutes — 1 day = 24 hours. 1 hour = 60 minutes. 1 minute = 60 seconds. 2 days = 48 hours. 3 hours = 180 minutes. 1 week = 7 days = 168 hours. To convert days to hours: multiply by 24. To convert hours to minutes: multiply by 60. Misconceptions: 'AM means morning only' (AM means before noon — from midnight 12:00 AM to 11:59 AM, including early morning), '12:00 PM is midnight' (12:00 PM is NOON/midday, 12:00 AM is midnight), '24-hour clock uses AM and PM' (24-hour clock does NOT use AM/PM — it uses hours 00-23), '1 hour = 100 minutes' (1 hour = 60 minutes, not 100), '1 day = 12 hours' (1 day = 24 hours — includes both day and night), 'all months have 30 days' (months have 30 or 31 days, February has 28 or 29). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function TimeCalendarGame), NOT export default. Export interface TimeCalendarGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
